data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Miscellaneous topicals & wound care_

**Class:** Pantothenic acid precursor (topical)

## Mechanism of action
- Converted to pantothenic acid (part of coenzyme A) → supports epidermal regeneration and barrier lipid synthesis; humectant and anti-inflammatory

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Minor wounds, post-laser/peel care, radiation dermatitis, nipple fissures, napkin dermatitis, dry skin, cheilitis with isotretinoin

## Dose & formulations
- 5% cream/ointment once or several times daily

## Adverse effects
- Allergic contact dermatitis (occasional)

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity

## Pregnancy & lactation
Safe.

## Viva points
- Wound-healing moisturiser; occasional contact allergen

_Sources: Khopkar ch.28 (Topical pantothenic acid). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
